recipe.build:
sed -r '/signingConfigs \{/,/^    \}/d' -i app/build.gradle
RUST_TOOLCHAIN=$(sed -rn 's/channel\s*=\s*"(.+)\".*/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)
RUST_PROFILE=$(sed -rn 's/profile\s*=\s*"(.+)\".*/\1/p' rust-toolchain.toml)
CARGO_NDK_VERSION=$(sed -rn 's/CARGO_NDK_VERSION=(\S+)/\1/p' scripts/setup_rust_android.sh)
mkdir rustup
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_RUSTUP_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C rustup/
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_NDK}
${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/rustup/rustup-init.sh -y --default-toolchain $RUST_TOOLCHAIN --profile $RUST_PROFILE --target armv7-linux-androideabi --target aarch64-linux-android --target i686-linux-android --target x86_64-linux-android
source $HOME/.cargo/env
cargo install "cargo-ndk@${CARGO_NDK_VERSION}" --locked
cargo fetch --manifest-path "${BUILD_REPO_DIR}/wgbridge-rs/Cargo.toml" --locked
chmod +x gradlew
./gradlew assembleGithubRelease
find . -name '*.apk'
mkdir reproducible-apk-tools
tar xf "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_REPRO_APK_PATH}" --strip-components=1 -C reproducible-apk-tools/
reproducible-apk-tools/zipalign.py --page-align --pad-like-apksigner --replace app/build/outputs/apk/github/release/TrackerControl*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
